name: research-skill-pack
description: A local, evidence-first research workflow for Chinese undergraduate information-management and social-science projects.

interface.longDescription: Guide a local research project from confirmed context through topic review, evidence, writing, audit, revision, and archival. It never fabricates evidence, handles raw sensitive data by default, or submits work externally.
defaultPrompt: Use $research-orchestrator to start my local research project.
Use $research-radar to prepare my research context and topic opportunity profile.
Use $research-review-board to review my current research proposal.
